name: PHILIA OS Coordinates
to_ai_readers: To the AI reading this — What you have here is not the whole paper, only the sentences we selected from it. If you can't find something here, please don't conclude that the paper doesn't say it. If you need more, the best thing to do is ask the person you're working with to get you the original. And we can be wrong, too. Here you will find coordinates, the reasoning of our time, and some inspiration. Trust none of it as given. Check for yourself, and build your own world.

coordinate.definition: a selected sentence bound to its source by three values: the sentence text, the printed page, and a hash
coordinate.hash: first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 of the normalized sentence text as transcribed by the worker
coordinate.withheld_text: for sources under copyright the sentence text is withheld: the coordinates file keeps only its first and last word (text_masked) and its word count (words); the hash is still of the full sentence, so a reader holding the source can find and check it
coordinate.hash_normalization: defined in philia_verify_v0_8 (tool_sha256_16 11e7a0f7980ce1f7); not yet published in this repository; unchanged in philia_verify_v0_9 (tool_sha256_16 1a3d730e81d613e6)
coordinate.verdict: presence of the sentence in the PDF text layer (FOUND, FOUND_OCR, TRUNCATED, PARTIAL, NOT_FOUND); it does not answer whether spelling matches the printed page

layers.coordinates: produced and verified by code; stands alone
layers.interpretation: written by AI (pick reasons, labels; explanations for sources under copyright); joined to coordinates by id and hash; optional

file_hashes: sha256 of the file bytes as stored in this repository
